name: ludo-royale
description: Ludo Royale — an original, offline, mobile-first Ludo game with a clean-room rules engine, CPU opponents, procedural audio and a PWA/Android shell.

scripts.cap:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:add: npm run build && npx cap add android
scripts.android:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:build: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.android:release: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
